channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
item.description: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

item.title: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
item.description: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

item.title: Senate hopeful's 'treading water' narrative crumbles under $500K campaign payouts to family
item.description: Dan Osborn's campaign has paid over $500,000 to family members even as the Nebraska Senate candidate claims his family is "treading water."

item.title: Taiwan analysts say Trump-Xi summit produced no policy shift but real test lies ahead
item.description: Taiwan analysts assess whether Xi Jinping secured private concessions from Trump, with arms sales and senior U.S. official visits as key tests ahead.

item.title: LEE CARTER: Trump can still get attention, can he distract voters from their bills?
item.description: Trump's approval on inflation sits at just 24% as polls show 62% of voters call grocery prices a major problem ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Schumer preaches affordability in Dem midterm pitch while sabotaging GOP fixes for soaring costs
item.description: Senate Democrats blocked GOP affordability and permitting reform bills, raising questions about their campaign messaging on cost of living issues.

item.title: MAHA moms are still up for grabs this election. They want more than cheap groceries
item.description: RFK Jr. has scored early wins on food additives and ultra-processed foods, but the GOP's stance on glyphosate and PFAS has frustrated MAHA moms.

item.title: SEN RAND PAUL: Our budget deficit is out of control. Congress must pass my Six Penny Plan
item.description: The U.S. national debt has surpassed $40 trillion, and my Six Penny Plan aims to balance the budget within five years by cutting six pennies per dollar.

item.title: Utah man released after decades on death row as DNA evidence excludes him from 1985 killing
item.description: A Utah man who spent decades on death row was released on bail after DNA evidence excluded him from the 1985 killing of a police chief's aunt.

item.title: Venezuelan national shot by ICE officer in Austin charged with assaulting federal officer
item.description: The Justice Department charged Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez with assaulting a federal officer after an Austin vehicle pursuit ended in an ICE shooting.

item.title: Fearing AI, workers go back to school seeking jobs that still need a human touch
item.description: Some people are abandoning office jobs for teaching, health care and the trades. But switching to the new paths can come with trade-offs.

item.title: Immigrant shot by ICE in Austin is charged with assault
item.description: An affidavit unsealed Tuesday said the officer who shot Wilber Garcés Pérez was not wearing a body camera and another officer had turned his camera off.

item.title: Hegseth bars military academies from hiring civilians as tenured professors
item.description: The move marks the latest effort by the Trump administration to exert more control over faculty at service academies.

item.title: Supreme Court allows third-country deportations to resume for now
item.description: The high court will later hear arguments and make a final ruling on the Trump administration’s controversial policy of sending migrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced
item.description: Jack Smith returned to Capitol Hill on Tuesday to defend his derailed efforts to prosecute President Donald Trump, telling lawmakers he would not “be silenced by continued threats of prosecution” from the president.

item.title: Hawaii’s wicked run of hurricanes is a preview of what El Niño has in store
item.description: Three hurricanes in the past month have given the state a taste of what a record-setting El Niño will bring to many this year.

item.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.
item.description: In rolling back fuel efficiency standards, the administration said the average new vehicle price in 2031 should be reduced by $1,300.

item.title: Education Department officially scraps Biden-era Title IX rules
item.description: The new regulations mark a return to rules from the first Trump administration.

item.title: U.S. ends health aid to Zimbabwe after ‘America First’ deal is spurned
item.description: The African nation refused to make an agreement with the Trump administration, which has sought to slash foreign assistance and impose new terms on recipients.

item.title: Some candidates are scrubbing their websites. Here is why that matters.
item.description: The trend says a lot about how candidates see this election, with the midterms just more than four weeks away.
